top_signals.title: Microsoft fixes bug behind ‘Defender Antivirus is turned off’ alerts
top_signals.summary: Microsoft has resolved a known issue that causes incorrect alerts warning that Defender Antivirus was turned off after installing recent updates. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
